_comment: Deterministic localized site settings for the Playwright E2E build only. Served by scripts/e2e-site-settings-fixture.mjs and consumed through the existing PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL seam, so no production or staging build can see it. Deliberately minimal: empty contentCopy keeps every gateway/header/footer copy fallback byte-identical to a settings-less build, so the only behavioural difference is a non-empty brandName (the field that decides whether .gw__title renders). brandName is the canonical value taken from tests/fixtures/contracts/responses/site.get.200.json — not invented, and the same locale-neutral string is used for both locales rather than guessing a localized spelling.

contentCopy.home.interests.lead: Human-centered AI, data systems and the interface between them.
